notes.title: The [Gluttony] demo has arrived!!
notes.content:
[p][b]The gates of Food Hell have opened! 🔥[/b][/p][p]The demo version of Team FG’s roguelike action game [b]\[Gluttony][/b] is now live on Steam!
Chomp down on burger devils, guzzle the blood of cola demons, and burst your Fullness Gauge as you fight your way through the depths of Food Hell.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Your feast fuels our fire.[/b]
We welcome all feedback, screenshots, and bug reports after your playthrough!
This is just the beginning of the gluttonous journey.
And don’t forget to [b]add us to your wishlist[/b]! 🍔👿[/p]
